verification_notes:
- Interface tier. The three suites the plan names (test-lint-roadmap-batch-proposals, test-orchestrate-conclusion-roadmap, test-orchestrate-recap) were run from the source store with CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store: 3 passed. shellcheck -S warning clean on the four files; check-task-references.sh = 0. grep for RUN_LINE_RE|detect_layout in the lint prints 0.
- The conclusion script's lint invocation already passed no --roadmap argument; the change there is that the lint now runs after the verdict case on every arm, and its findings block prints on the degrade arm too.
- The conclusion suite's sandbox never copied lib/file-scope-overlap.sh, so the lint had always exited 2 inside it unnoticed (its exit code is never acted on). The sandbox now copies that lib and roadmap-entries-lib.sh, and Cases A and C assert the lint's 'Scan complete.' line.
- Finding (f) scans nine bounded string fields and labels each finding with the field's state path; batch findings are labelled [milestone ID batch N] or [batch N] for the flat shape.
- The old suite's real-corpus default-resolution case was not carried over: from the source store the lint's default root resolves to the extension directory, so it only ever exercised the deployed copy.
